import CategoryTheory
import Data.Fin
import Data.Nat

open CategoryTheory

theorem lg_target {C : Type u₁} [CategoryTheory.Category.{u₂, u₁} C] (F : CategoryTheory.Functor C FintypeCat) {X Y : C} (i : X ≅ Y) : Nat.card (F.obj X).obj = Nat.card (F.obj Y).obj := by
  let f := i.hom
  let g := i.inv
  let h_iso : F.obj X ≅ F.obj Y := Functor.map_isomorphism F i
  let h_card_eq : Nat.card (F.obj X).obj = Nat.card (F.obj Y).obj :=
    by cases h_iso with f' g' hf hg; exact Nat.card_eq_of_bijective (equiv.of_bijective f' g' hf hg)
  exact h_card_eq
